decisions.label: Light knee
decisions.note: How bright the light on a pixel gets before it's eased off (every light summed: the party's, campfires, her glow, the moon). Lower: bright spots tamer.

decisions.label: Light ceiling
decisions.note: The most light a pixel ever gets, eased toward from the knee (at or under the knee: no easing, the old blow-out).

decisions.label: Soundsystem light
decisions.note: A partying soundsystem's own light, pulsing with the beat.

decisions.label: Bloom threshold
decisions.note: How bright a pixel must be to bloom (everywhere: neons, sigils, lit ground). Higher: less haze over bright ground.
